hero.headline: Your Vision, Built with Precision
hero.mainText: I'm a solo developer specializing in modern web applications. No overhead, no bureaucracy—just direct communication, fast delivery, and quality code. Let's turn your ideas into reality.

valueProposition.headline: Why Work With Me?
valueProposition.subheadline: Direct access, personal attention, and results that matter

speed.title: Fast Delivery
speed.description: From concept to deployment in weeks, not months. As a solo developer, I move quickly and make decisions fast.

quality.title: Quality Code
quality.description: Clean, maintainable code built with best practices and modern architecture. Every line is written with care.

transparency.title: Full Transparency
transparency.description: Direct communication, regular updates, and no surprises. You always know what's happening with your project.

partnership.title: Personal Partnership
partnership.description: I invest in your success. Your goals become my goals, and I'm committed to delivering exactly what you need.

features.headline: What I Offer
features.subheadline: Modern development, personal service, and results you can count on

rapidPrototyping.title: Rapid Prototyping
rapidPrototyping.description: Get from idea to working prototype in days. I move fast and iterate quickly to validate your concepts.

aiSolutions.title: AI Integration
aiSolutions.description: Leverage cutting-edge AI and machine learning to solve complex problems and enhance your applications.

modernStack.title: Modern Tech Stack
modernStack.description: Built with the latest technologies and frameworks for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

agile.title: Agile Development
agile.description: Flexible, iterative approach that adapts to your needs. We adjust as requirements evolve.

innovationLab.title: Innovation Focus
innovationLab.description: I experiment with emerging technologies to find creative solutions to your unique challenges.

startupFriendly.title: Startup-Friendly
startupFriendly.description: Designed for startups and small businesses who need results fast without breaking the bank.

freshPerspective.headline: Personal Service, Professional Results
freshPerspective.text: As a solo developer, I bring a fresh perspective to every project. No layers of management, no bureaucracy—just direct communication and focused execution. You work directly with me, the person building your solution, ensuring your vision is understood and implemented exactly as you imagine.

builtForInnovators.headline: Built for You, by Someone Who Cares
builtForInnovators.text: I understand what it's like to need solutions that work, fast, without enterprise overhead. I use the latest tools and technologies, stay current with best practices, and move at the speed you need. Every project is personal, and I'm committed to your success.

cta.headline: Ready to Build Something Amazing?
cta.subheadline: Let's turn your idea into reality. Fast, flexible, and focused on your success.

footer.tagline: Quality. Speed. Results. Building your vision, one project at a time.

hero.headline: Full-Stack Development Services
hero.mainText: From frontend to backend, I handle it all. Modern web applications built with the latest technologies, delivered fast and maintained with care.

intro.headline: Comprehensive Development Services
intro.subheadline: From concept to deployment, I've got you covered

consulting.title: Technical Consulting
consulting.description: Get expert advice on technology choices, architecture decisions, and best practices. I help you make informed decisions that set your project up for success.

implementation.title: Development & Implementation
implementation.description: Full-stack development with modern frameworks and best practices. I build scalable solutions that grow with your business, written with clean, maintainable code.

enablement.title: Knowledge Transfer
enablement.description: I document everything and provide training so you can maintain and extend your application. You own your code, and I make sure you understand it.

support.title: Support & Maintenance
support.description: Ongoing support to keep your systems running smoothly. Quick response times and proactive monitoring to prevent issues before they happen.

promotion.headline: Special Offer: MVP Package
promotion.text: Get your MVP to market faster with my comprehensive package. Includes rapid prototyping, core feature development, and deployment setup—all at a special rate for new clients.

whyChoose.headline: Why Work With a Solo Developer?
whyChoose.text: You get direct access to the person building your solution—no account managers, no project coordinators, just me. I understand your unique challenges and deliver solutions that drive real value. With flexible communication and fast iteration, you see progress weekly, not quarterly.

process.headline: My Process
process.text: We start with a conversation to understand your goals and requirements. Then I move quickly through design and development with regular check-ins. Every milestone delivers working software, and every update brings you closer to your vision. Simple, transparent, and results-focused.

contact.headline: Get in Touch
contact.subheadline: Have a project in mind? Let's discuss how I can help bring your ideas to life.

direct.headline: Prefer Direct Contact?
direct.text: You can also reach me directly via email. I typically respond within 24 hours.
